statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting PCI DSS for every role
Group CISO accountable; Group PCI program director named for PCI DSS
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis and targeted risk analyses; roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document inherited controls before signing a ROC or SAQ
Service providers: security review, PCI DSS terms, current evidence; acknowledgments to clients
Acquired businesses added to scope, SOC, and registers within 30 days
Annual independent assessment of common controls and division samples
Total price in every ticket and room price display; accurate fee descriptions
Payment page content authorized, inventoried, and monitored; no tags in checkout
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Retain security documentation at least 6 years
Unique identities from SYS-G1 for in-scope systems; no shared logins
Least privilege; full card display limited to named roles
MFA for all workforce; phishing-resistant for administrators; MFA into the CDE
Service accounts owned, governed, and rotated every 90 days
Immediate termination; automatic expiry for seasonal and contractor accounts
Quarterly access certification
Just-in-time privileged access; ticket-linked support access to client tenants
Vendor remote access only through PAM; no persistent tunnels
External identities: MFA offered; required for client administrators
Report suspected incidents to the SOC within 1 hour
One severity scale and group playbooks
Log time of suspicion and time of determination
Notice ownership by merchant role and for clients
Notification matrix and client notice register maintained; counsel approves notices
Escalate Severity 1 to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K within 4 business days of materiality
Annual cross-division exercise including notices and materiality
Evidence and payment page captures preserved with chain of custody
Owner, classification, and registered purpose for every dataset
Card data only in the CDE or P2PE devices; card numbers outside it destroyed within 1 business day
Minimization of feeds to group platforms; identity numbers never exported
Client data not pooled without contract permission
Restricted data encrypted in transit and at rest with group-controlled keys
Privacy notices describe tags, bot detection signals, and purposes
Retention schedule, including face templates and bot evidence
Secure destruction of media and consumer report information
No card numbers written, emailed, or keyed by phone agents
Inspect card devices before each shift
Only approved AI tools for group data
Annual awareness training; card-device module for contractor leads
